#!/bin/bash

# heartbeat.sh - Periodic monitoring endpoint caller

# Configuration
MONITORING_ENDPOINT="${HEARTBEAT_URL:-http://localhost:8080/health}"
INTERVAL="${HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL:-60}"  # Default 60 seconds
TIMEOUT="${HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT:-10}"    # Default 10 second timeout

# Logging function
log() {
    echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z')] $1"
}

log "Starting heartbeat monitor"
log "Endpoint: $MONITORING_ENDPOINT"
log "Interval: $INTERVAL seconds"

# Main loop
while true; do
    # Make the HTTP request with timeout
    if response=$(curl --silent --max-time "$TIMEOUT" --write-out "STATUS_CODE:%{http_code}" --output /tmp/heartbeat_response.txt "$MONITORING_ENDPOINT"); then
        # Extract status code
        status_code=$(echo "$response" | grep 'STATUS_CODE:' | cut -d: -f2)
        response_body=$(cat /tmp/heartbeat_response.txt)
        
        if [ "$status_code" -eq 200 ] || [ "$status_code" -eq 204 ]; then
            log "Heartbeat successful (HTTP $status_code)"
        else
            log "Heartbeat failed (HTTP $status_code): $response_body"
        fi
    else
        log "Heartbeat request failed: curl error"
    fi
    
    # Clean up
    rm -f /tmp/heartbeat_response.txt
    
    # Wait for the specified interval
    sleep "$INTERVAL"
done

# start-heartbeat.sh - Start heartbeat monitor with nohup

# .gitlab-ci.yml - CI/CD Pipeline Configuration

# This pipeline ensures the heartbeat monitor starts first to provide
# contextual debugging throughout the entire build process.

# Global variables
variables:
  # Heartbeat configuration
  HEARTBEAT_URL: "${HEARTBEAT_ENDPOINT:-http://localhost:8080/health}"
  HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL: "30"
  HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT: "10"
  HEARTBEAT_DEBUG: "true"

  # Pipeline control
  FF_DISABLE_UMASK_FOR_DOCKER_EXECUTOR: "true"

# Define pipeline stages
stages:
  - monitor    # Heartbeat monitoring (runs first)
  - build      # Build application
  - test       # Run tests
  - deploy     # Deploy application
  - cleanup    # Final cleanup

# Job to start heartbeat monitor (runs first)
.start-heartbeat:
  stage: monitor
  tags:
    - docker
  before_script:
    - echo "Starting heartbeat monitor..."
    - mkdir -p logs
    - chmod +x start-heartbeat.sh || true
    - chmod +x heartbeat.sh || true
  script:
    - |
      # Ensure no previous heartbeat is running
      if [ -f heartbeat.pid ]; then
        previous_pid=$(cat heartbeat.pid 2>/dev/null)
        if ps -p $previous_pid > /dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Killing previous heartbeat process (PID: $previous_pid)"
          kill $previous_pid || true
        fi
        rm -f heartbeat.pid
      fi
    - |
      # Start heartbeat with nohup
      echo "Starting heartbeat monitor in background..."
      nohup ./start-heartbeat.sh > logs/heartbeat.log 2>&1 &
      
      # Wait a moment for the process to start
      sleep 5
      
      # Verify it's running
      if [ -f heartbeat.pid ]; then
        heartbeat_pid=$(cat heartbeat.pid)
        if ps -p $heartbeat_pid > /dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Heartbeat successfully started with PID: $heartbeat_pid"
          echo "Heartbeat logs available at: logs/heartbeat.log"
        else
          echo "WARNING: heartbeat.pid exists but process is not running"
          exit 1
        fi
      else
        echo "ERROR: heartbeat.pid not created - heartbeat failed to start"
        cat logs/heartbeat.log || true
        exit 1
      fi
  after_script:
    - |
      # Always ensure heartbeat is stopped after this job
      if [ -f heartbeat.pid ]; then
        heartbeat_pid=$(cat heartbeat.pid)
        if ps -p $heartbeat_pid > /dev/null 2>&1; then
          echo "Stopping heartbeat monitor (PID: $heartbeat_pid)..."
          kill $heartbeat_pid || true
        fi
        rm -f heartbeat.pid
      fi
    - echo "Heartbeat monitor stopped."

# Actual job to start heartbeat (uses the template above)
start-heartbeat:
  <<: *start-heartbeat
  only:
    - main
    - merge_requests
  # This job runs first to ensure monitoring is active

# Build stage
build-application:
  stage: build
  tags:
    - docker
  before_script:
    - echo "Starting build at $(date)"
    - echo "Environment: $CI_ENVIRONMENT_NAME"
    - echo "Branch: $CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME"
    - echo "Commit: $CI_COMMIT_SHA"
  script:
    - |
      # Your build commands here
      echo "Building application..."
      # Example build commands:
      # npm install
      # npm run build
      # or
      # make build
      echo "Build completed successfully"
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - dist/
    expire_in: 1 week
  only:
    - main
    - merge_requests

# Test stage
run-tests:
  stage: test
  tags:
    - docker
  before_script:
    - echo "Starting tests at $(date)"
  script:
    - |
      # Your test commands here
      echo "Running tests..."
      # Example test commands:
      # npm test
      # or
      # make test
      echo "All tests passed!"
  only:
    - main
    - merge_requests

# Deploy stage
deploy-application:
  stage: deploy
  tags:
    - docker
  before_script:
    - echo "Starting deployment at $(date)"
  script:
    - |
      # Your deployment commands here
      echo "Deploying application..."
      # Example deployment commands:
      # npm run deploy
      # or
      # make deploy
      echo "Application deployed successfully"
  only:
    - main
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://your-app.example.com

# Cleanup stage
final-cleanup:
  stage: cleanup
  tags:
    - docker
  before_script:
    - echo "Starting cleanup at $(date)"
  script:
    - |
      # Cleanup commands
      echo "Cleaning up temporary files..."
      rm -rf node_modules || true
      rm -rf dist || true
      echo "Cleanup completed"
  when: always  # Always run, even if previous stages fail
  only:
    - main
    - merge_requests

# Cache configuration
cache:
  key: ${CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG}
  paths:
    - node_modules/
  policy: pull-push
